checks.method: Collect the default pytest selection and check that the CC-X04 test file is inside it.
checks.observed: tests/test_contract_compiler_historic_wire.py was absent from pyproject testpaths, so no gate collected it and the stale measurement stayed invisible. It is now listed, alongside the CC-X01, CC-X02 and baseline-inventory test files, and a test refuses any tests/test_contract_compiler_*.py outside testpaths.

limitations: This is a fresh measurement of current reader behavior, not a compatibility decision, migration, reader implementation, or release claim.
The reader coordinate names the commit that last changed this exact ten-file source set. Current bytes are checked mechanically against that set before observation.
The same five raw outcomes persisted across the source changes. That observation does not claim future behavior will remain unchanged.
Any later change to one of the ten bound reader inputs requires another fresh forward-only measurement, now produced by the recorded command rather than by hand.
The record action needs git and a clean reader source set. The check and render actions need neither.
